description: Three attenuverting channels, each with a one pole low pass and its own output, and a mix output that collects the channels nothing is patched to

params.text: Sets that channel's gain; the centre of its travel gives silence and the two ends give plus and minus one and a half times
Sets that channel's low pass corner, six octaves either side of C4 at 261.63Hz

inputs.text: Added straight into the mix output, for chaining another of these modules into it

outputs.text: That channel after its low pass and its gain; patching a cable here takes the channel out of the mix output
The sum of every channel whose own output has no cable in it, plus the LINK input

notes: patching a cable to a channel's own output removes that channel from the mix, which is what lets one channel be used as a plain attenuverter without disturbing the others
